keyEvents.text: Goal! Bologna 0, Monza 1. Gustavo Varela (Monza) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Ricardo Mangas (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bologna 1, Monza 1. Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Juan Miranda with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Bologna 1, Monza 1.
Substitution, Monza. Jay Robinson replaces Exequiel Zeballos.
Second Half begins Bologna 1, Monza 1.
Delay in match (Bologna). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lorenzo Lucchesi (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bologna 2, Monza 1. Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Bologna. Samuel Mbangula replaces Jens Odgaard.
Substitution, Monza. Mathis Mout replaces Leonardo Colombo.
Substitution, Monza. Idrissa Touré replaces Eddy Kouadio.
Substitution, Monza. Cyril Ngonge replaces Dany Mota.
Substitution, Monza. Patrick Cutrone replaces Gustavo Varela.
Nadir Zortea (Bologna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bologna. Oussama El Azzouzi replaces Tommaso Pobega.
Substitution, Bologna. Matteo Darmian replaces Martin Vitík.
Idrissa Touré (Monza) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Patrick Cutrone (Monza) right footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna).
Substitution, Bologna. Mikel Amondarain replaces Nadir Zortea.
Substitution, Bologna. Artem Dovbyk replaces Federico Bernardeschi.
Mikel Amondarain (Bologna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
